title: transit: routing toolkit with seven open issues (loader ids, Dijkstra penalties/ties, night timetables, zone fares, itinerary legs, loopless alternatives, network check)

issues.title: case-insensitive stop ids in the network file
shortest route: first boarding free, deterministic ties, unknown destination
earliest arrival: service times past midnight and inclusive transfer boundary
fares: distinct zones, half-up concession rounding, missing zone
itinerary legs per consecutive run and hour durations
alternative routes: loopless, inclusive max_extra, k validation
network check: one-way reachability, sorted messages, exit status
